# Joao de Queiroz

> Senior Software Engineer (backend, distributed systems, C#/.NET, AWS) based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. 7+ years building REST APIs, microservices, real-time and event-driven systems, and cloud infrastructure. Currently at Movida Aluguel de Carros.

## Experience

### Movida Aluguel de Carros — Software Engineer (Aug 2023 – present, Remote)
Backend for SAT 24/7, Movida's vehicle assistance and tracking platform, focused on roadside assistance: towing, locksmiths, batteries and tyres, coordinated across all of Brazil. Scale: 300,000+ tracked vehicles, 7,000+ service providers, 50,000+ service requests a month.
- Designed and built a reusable real-time notification platform (SignalR and a REST API), now used by 3 microservices. It replaced frontend polling, so notifications are instant and CPU usage dropped
- Moved a synchronous notification call out of the response path of two decision-tree endpoints: that step went from 0.5–3 s to under 50 ms, and the lightest flow from 3–5 s to 2.3–3 s
- Resolved a database outage caused by exponential growth in stored notifications, separating the ones that must be persisted from real-time-only SignalR events that trigger UI actions
- Traced a geofence outage across several microservices and two SQS queues to a Redis instance mismatch, and coordinated with other teams to restore consistent event processing
- Builds and maintains the REST APIs used by internal systems and 7,000+ service providers
- Delivers features end to end across .NET and Angular 17, with Product Owners from development to release
- Works on AWS (EC2, RDS, ECR, S3, SQS) with Docker and Azure DevOps pipelines
- Uses Cursor, an AI-assisted editor, every day to speed up refactoring and debugging
- Stack: .NET Core, C#, SignalR, EF Core, MySQL, Redis, SQS, Angular 17, AWS, Docker, Microservices

### DHAUZ — Software Engineer (Aug 2022 – Aug 2023, Remote)
Worked on two SaaS products: Uorkz, a subscription-based tech talent marketplace with AI-assisted matching, and a sales-forecasting platform built on machine-learning and LLM services.
- Automated per-subscriber infrastructure with CloudFormation: setting up a new customer went from over an hour of manual work to 3–5 minutes
- Built the AWS infrastructure: EC2, RDS, SQS, S3, Route 53, CloudFormation
- Integrated the .NET services with the AI/ML systems to exchange data and deliver predictions
- Built .NET Core services, REST APIs and SQS-based asynchronous processing for both platforms
- Designed multi-tenant database schemas in MySQL
- Contributed Angular front-end work to ship features end to end
- Set up Docker workflows connected to CI/CD pipelines
- Stack: .NET Core, C#, ABP Framework, AWS, CloudFormation, SQS, MySQL, Angular 13, Docker

### MODALGR — Software Engineer (Sep 2021 – Aug 2022, Remote)
Built backend modules and microservices for Hexagon.pro (now HX | TOS), a terminal operating system, on its bulk-cargo solution for the grain export chain, during initial development before customer launch.
- Implemented truck and rail arrival workflows: scheduling, gate entry, initial and final weighing, and unloading
- Built storage features: silo and warehouse occupancy, transfers between silos and grain quality tracking by lot
- Built ship loading: vessel line-up, loading plans and records of loading stoppages
- Implemented commercial workflows between exporters, with supporting documents and invoicing
- Wrote data access with Dapper and optimised Oracle queries for performance-critical operations
- Applied DDD and SOLID to keep the codebase clean and testable
- Worked with Product Owners to match solutions to logistics needs
- Stack: C#, .NET Core, Dapper, Oracle, DDD, Clean Architecture, SOLID

### ed (client: CAIXA) — Software Engineer (May 2021 – Sep 2021, Rio de Janeiro)
Worked on XCAP do Bem, CAIXA's online platform for selling capitalisation bonds, where every transaction has to be right.
- Built backend APIs and business logic in .NET Core and EF Core
- Wrote unit tests first (TDD) with xUnit
- Designed MySQL structures for transactional flows
- Debugged and resolved production issues
- Worked in CI/CD workflows on Azure DevOps
- Stack: C#, .NET Core, EF Core, MySQL, xUnit, TDD

### Log Planning (client: Ipiranga) — Ensemble Developer (Dec 2018 – May 2021, Rio de Janeiro)
Built integrations between systems for Ipiranga, one of Brazil's largest fuel distributors, on InterSystems Ensemble. Started as an intern, became a developer in Mar 2020.
- Rewrote and adjusted 100+ integrations affected by an ERP upgrade
- Built SOAP and REST integrations using a service-oriented (SOA) architecture
- Set up new integrations in the Kong API gateway
- Fixed bugs and reviewed code for the integration team
- Stack: InterSystems Ensemble, SOAP, REST, SOA, Kong

## Side projects

- [GeekShopping](https://github.com/joaogqueiroz/GeekShopping): e-commerce platform split into .NET 8 microservices (products, cart, coupons, orders, payments, email) behind an Ocelot API gateway, with IdentityServer auth, RabbitMQ messaging and Docker Compose; each cart is tied to the signed-in user's token; unit and API tests against SQL Server in containers
- [DevFreela](https://github.com/joaogqueiroz/DevFreela): freelancer marketplace API on .NET 8 with CQRS, MediatR, JWT roles and EF Core; finishing a project sends the payment to DevFreela.Payments over RabbitMQ; unit tests and API tests against SQL Server and RabbitMQ in containers (xUnit, Testcontainers)
- [DevFreela.Payments](https://github.com/joaogqueiroz/DevFreela.Payments): payment microservice split out of DevFreela; consumes payment requests over RabbitMQ, checks the card data (Luhn, CVV, expiry) and publishes a payment-approved event only for approved payments; tested end to end against RabbitMQ in a container (.NET 8)
- [MyMovieScore](https://github.com/joaogqueiroz/MyMovieScore): movie list and rating API on .NET 8 with details and external ratings from OMDb, JWT auth, clean architecture, CQRS, Docker Compose, Swagger; unit and API tests against SQL Server in a container
- [TaskControl](https://github.com/joaogqueiroz/TaskControl): task management web app with progress charts and PDF reports (ASP.NET Core MVC, .NET 8, Dapper, SQL Server, Highcharts); unit tests and repository tests against SQL Server in a container
